notes.title: Bow Course Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Greetings Archers!
We have an update to the demo's tutorial to make it clearer and easier to understand how to proceed.

The tutorial update includes:
Text improvements

Clearer highlights for buttons & controls

Destination marker stays visible so players know where to stand

Player movement is disabled when standing in front of the rules board to reduce confusion 

Thank you for playing the demo! Let us know what you think in the Steam forums and happy archery golfing!
